sanity_expectations: vy(0) = 25 m/s and h(0) = 0 m exactly
vy is monotonically decreasing while the projectile ascends (t<~2.5 s), passes through zero near the apex, then continues decreasing as gravity dominates during descent
h rises to an apex (~30 m before drag/lift corrections) around t~2-3 s, returns to zero, then goes negative as vy stays negative through the rest of the window
dvy_dt stays finite and real across the whole window (verified by check_substitution at a representative descent state)
The oscillatory (C_L, omega) term produces a visible sinusoidal ripple superimposed on the drag+gravity trend, with amplitude growing with vy^2 and modulated by exp(-h/H)
Trajectories from this child system diverge measurably from the parent (exp(-vy/H)) trajectory as t approaches 10 s — that divergence is the new-mechanism signal
excitation_report: Child-vs-parent ODE-system excitation on target vy: new mechanism (exp(-h/H) replacing exp(-vy/H) in the drag and lift terms) peaks at 19.55*sigma at t=10.0 s, well above the 5*sigma threshold. Confirmed by extending the sampling to t in [0,10] s and setting H=50 m so h and vy sweep across meaningfully different exponent arguments as the projectile rises, falls, and continues past the launch reference altitude. Each additive term in dvy_dt is order 1-15 m/s^2 at the sampled state, dwarfing sigma=0.5 m/s^2.
role_corrections: t: V->V (confirmed as the sole independent time axis)
vy: S->S (confirmed dynamic state, target of the ODE)
h: S->S (confirmed dynamic state; its trivial governing equation dh/dt=vy is inherited from the contract)
H: P->P (confirmed scale height, fixed at compressed 50 m to keep the new h-vs-vy attenuation distinguishable on the sampled trajectory)

b: P->P (confirmed; note the label calls b an altitude-dependence coefficient but structurally b multiplies vy, so it is a constant coefficient of a velocity-linear gravity modulation, not an altitude coupling — kept as a plain parameter)
omega: P->P (confirmed oscillation angular frequency, fixed)
rationale: Typed ODE contract inherited exactly (equation_type=ode_system, integrator=integrate_system, state_variables=[vy,h], state_rhs and initial_conditions unchanged). Only sampling range, parameter values, and noise chosen. Time window [0,10] s covers the initial ascent, apex, descent, and continues past the launch reference so h becomes negative and exp(-h/H) diverges from exp(-vy/H) — this is what makes the new h-dependent atmospheric attenuation visible relative to the parent's velocity-based attenuation. H=50 m is a compressed scale height (not standard 8500 m) but is required physically to make the altitude-vs-velocity distinction excite on the sampled trajectory; larger H makes the new mechanism indistinguishable within sensible flight times. Other parameters set to plausible small-projectile values: g=9.81 m/s^2, m=1 kg, k=0.02 kg/m (k/m=0.02 /m quadratic drag), eps=0.5 m/s regularization, b=0.005 s/m so 2*b*vy is a few percent gravity modulation at launch, C_L=0.005 kg/m for a modest oscillatory lift, omega=5 rad/s spin frequency.
